detail.howItWorksBody: When you say “I have it”, a private chat opens with Melha to agree on details and value — once you agree, the request automatically becomes a normal exchange on Namliya with its familiar statuses.
detail.iHaveCta: I have it — we can do it

addRequest.title: Got Qalish? — Post a request
addRequest.titlePlaceholder: e.g. Storage space for stage sets
addRequest.descriptionPlaceholder: What exactly do you need? What makes a reply a good fit?
addRequest.tip1: First make sure what’s needed isn’t already available — search Namliya and Khalis.
addRequest.tip2: Requests surface unmet need, and help Shahamham choose the next organizations to join.
addRequest.tip3: As soon as someone says “I have it” and you agree in chat, the request converts automatically into a normal exchange.
addRequest.tip4: Public audience needs gather in Shbeik Lbeik — not here.
addRequest.titleMin: Title must be at least 3 characters
